interpretation.result: All 630 pair scores match the frozen main-thread CPU evidence; grouping remains unchanged. Unthrottled throughput stays about 5.3 seconds for 36 frames while main-thread timer lateness improves.
interpretation.timer: Timer lateness throughout harness setup/inference, not frame-rate, input latency, a worst-case bound, or physical-device performance. Summary distributions only; raw timer samples were not retained by this run.
interpretation.stress: CDP page throttling is requested at 4x; effective worker-thread throttling is not calibrated. The 23.8s vs 6.3s stress passes must not be presented as a same-CPU speedup.
interpretation.cleanup: Both forms terminate/revoke on cancellation and restart successfully. Cancellation settlement time is promise rejection latency, not proof of immediate native-memory reclamation. Graceful model disposal reports zero tensors; abrupt termination has no final tensor census.
interpretation.next: Implement a bounded opt-in suggestions preview with explicit apply, generation-safe cancellation, manual group/Keep preservation and unchanged non-ML fallback. No automatic grouping or default-on ML. Physical Android/iPhone validation and broader independent labels remain required before broad/default adoption.
